# What is the correct export order for Sim2Sim after training in Humanoid-Gym?

> **Current answer:** Use train.py to train, then run play.py to export a JIT model for deployment. Transfer the policy paths from logs/XBot_ppo/exported/policies to sim2sim.py. When adapting to a new robot, verify the MJCF and URDF joint mapping, and do not only replace file names.
